commercial_truth.name: Spreadsheet Rescue
commercial_truth.description: Human-assisted repair and recovery of a broken spreadsheet workflow.

execution.fulfilment_method: Customer supplies the spreadsheet and describes the failure; seller repairs the agreed issue and returns the repaired file or a documented diagnosis if repair is not possible.
execution.fulfilment_condition: Payment settled and customer materials received.
execution.refund_rule: Refund handling is governed by the applicable sale terms.

requirements: output file hash or diagnosis artifact
evidence.verification_rule: A verifier must be able to establish that payment settled, the customer material was received, and the promised delivery artifact was produced.
